Name: thoughts_do_not_travel
Title: Actions Travel, Thoughts Don't: The Writer's Reasoning Text Is the Non-Transferable Part of Cross-Backbone Agent Experience, and a Deterministic Strip Matches a Model-Aware Rewriter at Matched Tokens
Short Hypothesis: The component of a stored experience item that fails to transfer across backbones is the writer's reasoning text (ReAct thoughts, think blocks, analysis-channel text), not its action-observation sequence and not its scaffold. At fixed retrieved items and fixed reader scaffold, deleting the writer's thoughts raises a foreign reader's success by >= 5 net points and does not raise the writer's own (a writer x reader interaction on byte-identical injected strings); converting the scaffold while keeping the thoughts recovers little; the harm follows the author of the thoughts, not the author of the actions (the reader's own post-hoc thoughts on foreign actions remove it, a foreign backbone's post-hoc thoughts on the reader's own actions reproduce it); and a model-aware LLM rewriter at matched tokens adds nothing over the zero-cost strip. The fix for producer-consumer mismatch on this class of items is a parser, not a model.
Related Work: Skill is Not One-Size-Fits-All (arXiv:2605.30723) fixes model-dependent skill utility with a trained model-aware rewriter; SkillAligner (arXiv:2608.06880) and SkillAdaptor (arXiv:2606.01311) adapt retrieved procedural skills at execution time; SkillRevise (arXiv:2606.01139) reports cross-model transfer of revised skills; the portable-memory protocol (arXiv:2605.11032) includes a rehydration step that adapts recalled content to the target model but never compares it with no adaptation. None of them asks which part of an item fails to travel, and none runs a zero-cost strip as the baseline for the rewriter. In the knowledge-distillation home literature, rationale mismatch between teacher and student is a known failure: token-selective distillation lets the student 'explain in its own words' (arXiv:2603.13260), rationale selection by accuracy/diversity/difficulty (arXiv:2509.23574), symbolic CoT distillation (arXiv:2306.14050), and provenance tracing shows which sentences of a distilled model come from the teacher (arXiv:2512.20908); these are parametric, and the in-context analog with writer identity manipulated (and with the author of the rationale swapped at fixed actions, the in-context form of 'own words') has not been run. The archived idea abstraction_discards_bindings_and_repairs (5.95) varied abstraction level (raw vs summary) within one writer; this proposal holds abstraction fixed (raw trajectories) and varies which component (thought vs action vs scaffold) is kept and who authored it, with writer != reader.
Abstract: When an experience item written by one backbone is read by another, part of the writer's gain is lost. We test the claim that the lost part is carried by the writer's reasoning text and not by its actions or its scaffold. On ALFWorld, three backbones (Qwen3-32B, EXAONE-4.0-32B, gpt-oss-120b) each collect a success-filtered pool on the same 3,553 training games at the same episode budget; the expert walkthrough pool (no thoughts) is a fourth, already-stripped writer. Retrieval is by task-description embedding at k=3, so within a writer's pool every reader receives byte-identical items and every serialization of a cell contains the same items: F1 verbatim in the writer's scaffold; F1r thoughts kept, actions and observations re-serialized by a deterministic parser into the reader's scaffold; F2 the parser with the thought slot deleted; F3 the reader's own thoughts written teacher-forced over the writer's actions at the writer's thought length; F4 a model-aware LLM rewriter (arXiv:2605.30723-style prompt on the reader) capped at F2's token count; F5 the reader's own actions with thoughts written teacher-forced by a foreign backbone (and by itself, the post-hoc comparator); F6 thoughts only. The headline estimand is Delta_strip = S(F2) - S(F1r) and its writer x reader interaction: we predict >= +5 net pooled over the six cross cells and <= +1 pooled over the three same-backbone cells, which inject the same strings to their own author, so a token-length or dead-weight account of the cross-cell gain is excluded by an arm rather than assumed away. We further predict that scaffold conversion alone recovers <= +2, that reader-authored thoughts on foreign actions recover >= +5 over writer-authored thoughts of the same length, that foreign-authored thoughts on the reader's own actions cost >= 5, that the rewriter's residual over the strip is <= +2 at matched tokens, and that thoughts alone sit within +2 of the best static prompt against the +17.2 that action items carry (Measurement C). Six seeds on the headline cells and pooled, game-clustered bootstrap CIs put every predicted value and its falsifier outside the design noise. If the predictions hold, the adaptation cost reported by rewriter papers is paid for nothing on this class of items; if own thoughts are dead weight too, the same arms say so.
Experiments: Readers and writers: Qwen3-32B (Q), EXAONE-4.0-32B (E), gpt-oss-120b (G), served in vLLM 0.13, one replica per A100 (Gate V: k=0 >= 0.30 for E and G). Pools: Q-self (on disk) and E-self, G-self collected on the same 3,553 training games at the same episode budget (one attempt per game, success-filtered; about 7,100 episodes, 10-12 GPU-hours on GPU1 while GPU0 runs the Q->Q cells); expert pool X (on disk, no thoughts). A 'thought' is every model-generated token in a step except the action string (Thought lines and <think> blocks for Q and E, analysis-channel text for G). Items whose F1r form exceeds 1,500 tokens are dropped from that writer's pool for every serialization (count reported), so the retrieved set is identical across serializations and across readers. Retrieval: task-description embedding, k=3, fixed; within a writer pool every reader receives byte-identical items. Serializations: F1 verbatim in the writer's scaffold, thoughts kept; F1r thoughts kept verbatim, actions and observations re-serialized by the deterministic parser into the reader's scaffold template (F1r = F1 in same-backbone cells); F2 the same parser with the thought slot deleted (action + observation lines only, same k=3 items, fewer tokens); F3 the reader's own thoughts written teacher-forced over the writer's action-observation sequence in one offline pass (per-step length target = the writer's per-step thought length +/-20%, so F3 is token-matched to F1r per item); F4 a model-aware rewriter prompt on the reader model following arXiv:2605.30723's description (the reader rewrites the item for itself, free to restructure, add or delete), output capped per item at the F2 token count (one regeneration with a tighter instruction, then truncation; realized tokens logged; a cell is valid only if mean F4 tokens are within 10% of F2); F5 (reader Q only) the Q-self pool's own action sequences with thoughts written teacher-forced by E (F5-E), by G (F5-G) or by Q itself (F5-self, the post-hoc own-authored comparator, which is also the matched writer = reader case of F3), length-matched to Q's original thoughts; F6 thoughts only (actions and observations deleted). Cells and seeds (274 eval games per seed): Phase A, 6 seeds (1,644 episodes per arm): 6 cross cells x {F1r, F2} = 12 arms and 3 same-backbone cells x {F1, F2} = 6 arms, 29,592 episodes. Phase A': F1 in the 6 cross cells at 2 seeds (3,288); static3 (Measurement C's best static arm, cached) for E and G at 4 seeds plus 2 extra seeds for Q (2,740); k=0 for E and G at 2 seeds (1,096). Phase B, 4 seeds (1,096 per arm) unless stated: F3 and F4 in the 6 cross cells (13,152); F5-self, F5-E, F5-G at 6 seeds (4,932); F6 in 2 cross cells, reader Q and reader E each with the writer of largest Phase-A verbatim deficit (2,192); X->E and X->G in F2 form at 2 seeds (1,096); memory-absent F3/F4 (both prompts with the item field empty collapse to the reader writing an item from the task description alone) for the 3 readers at 2 seeds (1,644); F4 matched (Q rewriting Q-self items) at 2 seeds (548). Total about 60,300 episodes. At the 9-10 episodes/min across both replicas that the previous version's 2-day estimate for 27,000 episodes assumed, Phase A+A' (36,700 episodes; decides P1, P2 and Gate 0) takes about 2.7 days and Phase B about 1.7 days; pool collection and the offline F3/F4/F5 passes (about 11,400 reader passes and 3 x 1,900 rewriter passes, 4-6 GPU-hours) overlap on the second GPU during single-reader phases. Readers are sequenced Q, E, G with both GPUs serving the current reader and clients spread across replicas tuned to the vLLM queue; a reader's offline passes run while it is served. Pre-registered cut order if Phase B overruns: X, then F6 to one cell, then F3/F4 to the 4 cross cells with the largest Phase-A verbatim deficit. Capability is held fixed by construction: every claim is a within-cell contrast of serializations of the same items to the same reader; the 3 x 3 writer x reader factor is reported but no ordering claim is made on it.
Baselines and Ablations: k=0 per reader; static3 (Measurement C, +12.4 over k=0 for Q) per reader, every gain reported net of it; reader's own pool verbatim at matched collection cost (F1, R->R, the self-pool reference and the denominator of the retained-gain ratio); the writer's own gain from its pool (second denominator); expert pool X (already-stripped anchor) in F2 form for E and G, X->Q from Measurement C (k3 = +17.2 over static3); F1 vs F1r vs F2 at matched k and matched items (scaffold conversion vs thought deletion, on the same retrieved items); F3 token-matched to F1r (authorship swap at fixed actions and length); F4 token-capped to F2 (content adaptation at fixed length), plus F4 memory-absent (must be within +/-4 of static3) and F4 matched (Q on Q-self); F5 block with F5-self (post-hoc own thoughts) as the comparator, so provenance is the only difference between F5-self, F5-E and F5-G; F6 thoughts-only placebo against static3 and against F2; wrong-type placebo cited from Measurement C (blind1, -3 under k=0), not re-run; token counts of every injected context reported next to every gain; seen vs unseen split; retained-gain ratio per cell and serialization with bootstrap CIs.
Falsifiable Predictions:
P1 (headline: writer x reader interaction on thought presence). Estimand Delta_strip = S(F2) - S(F1r): same retrieved items, same reader scaffold, thoughts deleted. (a) Pooled over the 6 cross cells Delta_strip >= +5 net with 95% CI lower bound > +2; (b) pooled over the 3 same-backbone cells Delta_strip <= +1 with CI upper bound < +3; (c) interaction (a) - (b) >= +4 with CI lower bound > 0; secondary: per-cell Delta_strip CI excludes 0 in at least 4 of 6 cross cells. Falsified if the pooled cross CI upper bound < +3 (foreign thoughts are harmless or useful; produced by the F1r/F2 cross arms), or if pooled same-backbone Delta_strip >= +3 with CI lower bound > 0 (own thoughts are dead weight too: a token-efficiency effect, not a mismatch effect; produced by the F1/F2 same-backbone arms, which inject the very strings the cross cells inject), or if the interaction CI includes 0. Design noise +/-1.2, +/-1.75, +/-2.1 pooled (measured basis; +/-1.9, +/-2.7, +/-3.3 conservative): a true +5 and a true 0 are both recoverable on either basis. Reported alongside: recovery fraction Delta_strip / verbatim deficit in Gate-0 cells with CI (the 'most of the deficit' reading requires >= 0.5; reported, not pass/fail, because the deficit CI makes the ratio wide near 6).
P2 (it is the thoughts, not the scaffold). Delta_scaffold = S(F1r) - S(F1), thoughts kept, scaffold converted, pooled over the 6 cross cells: <= +2 with CI upper bound < +4, and Delta_strip - Delta_scaffold >= +3 with CI lower bound > 0. Falsified if pooled Delta_scaffold >= +4 with CI lower bound > 0 and Delta_scaffold >= Delta_strip (the non-transferable part is the scaffold; a parser still fixes it but the title is wrong). Produced by F1 (2 seeds) against F1r (6 seeds); noise +/-1.75 (+/-2.7).
P3 (a model-aware rewriter adds nothing over the strip at matched tokens). Delta_rewrite = S(F4) - S(F2), pooled over the 6 cross cells: <= +2 with CI upper bound < +4, and no cell >= +6 with CI excluding 0. Falsified if pooled Delta_rewrite >= +4 with CI lower bound > 0, or 2 or more cells >= +6 with CI excluding 0 (content adaptation beyond form matters; reachable because the rewriter may restructure, delete steps or add procedure text inside the same token budget). If memory-absent F4 exceeds static3 by >= 6, the rewriter is a procedure writer and Delta_rewrite is re-based on that arm. Noise +/-1.4 (+/-2.1).
P4 (the harm follows the author of the thoughts: foreign actions). (a) S(F3) - S(F1r) pooled over the 6 cross cells >= +5 with CI lower bound > +2: same actions, same length, reader-authored instead of writer-authored thoughts. Falsified if the CI upper bound < +3 (any thoughts attached to foreign actions hurt, or the foreign actions themselves do; produced by the F3 arm). (b) DoD = [S(F3) - S(F2)] pooled cross minus [S(F1) - S(F2)] pooled same-backbone (what the reader's own thoughts add on foreign actions minus what they add on its own actions, corrected by the post-hoc offset S(F5-self) - S(F1, Q->Q) if that offset's CI excludes 0): |DoD| <= 2 with CI inside [-5, +5]. Falsified if |DoD| >= 5 with CI excluding 0 (own thoughts help only on own actions, or re-rationalizing a foreign sequence teaches more than it costs). (b) is not fixed by P1: P1(b) bounds the same-backbone term from above only, and (b) asserts equality whatever that term is. Noise +/-1.4 for (a), +/-2.2 for (b) (+/-2.1, +/-3.4).
P5 (the harm follows the author of the thoughts: own actions). Reader Q, own action sequences: pooled S(F5-E), S(F5-G) minus S(F5-self) <= -5 with CI upper bound < -1, and each source individually <= -3. Falsified if the pooled CI upper bound >= 0 or the point estimate >= -2 (foreign thoughts hurt only when paired with foreign actions, i.e., the harm is a property of the whole item, not of the thoughts). Produced by the F5 block at 6 seeds, three arms on the same items with teacher-forced thoughts of matched length; noise +/-2.1 (+/-3.3). S(F5-self) - S(F1, Q->Q) is reported as the post-hoc offset.
P6 (placebo: the thoughts do not carry the procedure). In the two F6 cells, pooled S(F6) - static3 <= +2 with CI upper bound < +5, against Measurement C's action-item residual of +17.2 for X->Q, and S(F2) - S(F6) >= +8 with CI lower bound > +3 in the same cells. Falsified if pooled F6 - static3 >= +6 with CI lower bound > 0, or if S(F2) - S(F6) has CI upper bound < +5 (thoughts alone carry most of what the item carries; P1 would then be thought style competing with usable content). Noise +/-2.6, +/-2.4 (+/-4.0, +/-3.7).
Gate 0 (deficit gate, framing only): verbatim deficit S(F1, R->R) - S(F1, W->R) pooled over the 6 cross cells >= 6 net with CI lower bound > +2, or at least one cell >= 6 with CI lower bound > 0 (2-seed F1 cross against 6-seed F1 same, +/-4.3 per cell, +/-1.75 pooled). P1-P6 run regardless; if Gate 0 fails, the recovery fraction is not reported and the claim is stated as harm-and-removal rather than deficit recovery.
Gate V: k=0 >= 0.30 for E and G in vLLM 0.13; a reader failing Gate V is kept as writer and dropped as reader (3 writers x 2 readers, 4 cross and 2 same cells, pooled noise recomputed to +/-1.5 cross and +/-2.1 same).
Measurement and Noise Control: Success is measured on the 274 ALFWorld eval games (seen 140 / unseen 134), paired by game and seed across arms of the same reader; net points are success x 100 minus the reader's static3. Design noise is taken from Measurement C's paired k3 - static3 contrast, CI half-width +/-5.25 net at 274 x 2 seeds, scaled as sqrt(2/S): per-cell paired half-width +/-3.0 at 6 seeds, +/-3.7 at 4, +/-5.25 at 2; contrast of a 4-seed against a 6-seed arm +/-3.4, of a 2-seed against a 6-seed arm +/-4.3; pooled estimands divide by sqrt(number of cells): pooled cross Delta_strip (6 cells, 6 seeds) +/-1.2, pooled same Delta_strip (3 cells) +/-1.75, interaction +/-2.1, pooled Delta_scaffold +/-1.75, pooled Delta_rewrite and F3 - F1r +/-1.4, difference-of-differences +/-2.2, pooled F5 - F5-self (2 sources, 6 seeds) +/-2.1, pooled F6 - static3 (2 cells, 4 vs 4 seeds) +/-2.6, F2 - F6 +/-2.4. The brief's conservative floor (+/-8 at 2 seeds) gives 1.5x these figures (+/-4.6 per cell at 6 seeds, +/-1.9 pooled cross, +/-3.3 interaction); every margin is set so that the predicted value and the falsifying value are each recoverable on the measured basis and still separated on the conservative one. All CIs are game-level cluster bootstrap (games are the cluster, seeds and cells nested), which absorbs the correlation between cells that share games; if the realized pooled width exceeds 1.5x the design figure, per-cell criteria are reported as the result. The pre-registered pass/fail criteria are the pooled ones; per-cell criteria are secondary. Retrieval is identical across serializations and across readers of one pool by construction, so every Delta is a within-retrieval, within-item contrast and no arm differs in the number of demonstrations. Token counts of every injected context are logged and reported next to every gain; F3 is token-matched to F1r and F4 to F2 per item, so F1r-F2, F3-F1r and F4-F2 are content contrasts, not length contrasts; the F1r-F2 length difference is the deleted thoughts themselves, and the same-backbone cells (same strings, own reader) are the control for length per se. Margins are fractions of the Gate-0 effect (6 net) and of Measurement C's +17.2 (P1 margin = 0.8 of Gate 0; P6 bound = 0.12 of the action-item residual). Seen and unseen reported separately. F3/F4/F5 passes run once and frozen; their token cost enters the per-cell cost table. Retained-gain ratio per cell and serialization with bootstrap CIs, two denominators (reader's own F2 gain, writer's own F1 gain).

Risk Factors and Limitations: gpt-oss-120b analysis text is long: items whose F1r form exceeds 1,500 tokens are dropped from G's pool for all serializations (count reported; if more than 30% of G's successes are dropped, G's pool is re-collected at low reasoning effort and the change reported). Teacher-forced thoughts (F3, F5) are post-hoc rationalizations, while F1/F1r thoughts were written before the action; F5-self measures that offset once (same author, post-hoc vs causal), P4(b) and P5 subtract it if its CI excludes 0, and if it is >= 5 the authorship claims are stated relative to post-hoc thoughts only. ALFWorld's action vocabulary is shared, so the mismatch manipulated is reasoning text and scaffold, not action vocabulary; a manufactured action-vocabulary mismatch (macro-action writer scaffold) is a follow-up. The rewriter is a prompted, not trained, version of arXiv:2605.30723; a trained rewriter could exceed it, which is why P3 is bounded (<= +2) rather than set at zero, and the SkillAligner execution-time variant is deferred for budget. If P1(b) fails (own thoughts dead weight), the finding is a token-efficiency result and is reported as a falsification of the mismatch claim, not re-framed. If P1(a) holds but P4(a) fails, thoughts of any author hurt on foreign actions and the claim narrows to presence rather than authorship; both outcomes are pre-registered readings. Gate V for E and G serving is unverified; a reader failing it stays a writer. Budget is about 60,300 episodes, roughly 4.5 days on two A100s at the previously assumed 9-10 episodes/min, with the headline phase (36,700 episodes, about 2.7 days) first and a pre-registered cut order for Phase B. Pooled criteria assume cells are not strongly positively correlated through shared games; the game-cluster bootstrap reports the realized width and the fallback to per-cell criteria is pre-registered.
Addresses gap: G5 (transfer when the consumer's format differs from the producer's, and the role of explicit reader-side adaptation over no adaptation), with G1's retained-gain ratio reported per writer x reader cell and per serialization with CIs.
Not a restatement of: Nearest brief bullet: Measurement A (the expert pool, which has no thoughts, transfers +27/+32 to Qwen3-32B) and Measurement C (k3 - static3 = +17.2 for that pool). This idea claims that the absence of writer thoughts is why that pool travels, tested by adding and removing thoughts on the same action sequences with the writer manipulated and the author of the thoughts swapped in both directions; Measurements A and C have one writer and one serialization. Nearest digest card: arXiv:2605.30723 (skill utility is model-dependent and a model-aware rewriter fixes it). This idea claims a zero-cost deterministic strip accounts for what the rewriter fixes and that the residual value of thoughts is a property of the reader, which the card cannot show because it has no strip arm, no scaffold-only arm, no authorship swap and no matched-token comparison. Archived closer_beats_stronger varied writers of different capability; here every claim is a within-cell contrast at fixed writer and fixed reader, so capability is held constant and only the item's form and thought authorship vary. Archived abstraction_discards_bindings_and_repairs varied abstraction within one writer; here abstraction is fixed and the writer is varied.
Changes made: P1: estimand changed from F2-at-matched-tokens minus F1 (which confounded extra demonstrations and scaffold conversion with thought removal) to F2 - F1r at matched k, matched items and reader scaffold; the matched-token F2 arm is cut; same-backbone cells raised to 6 seeds like the cross cells; the three clauses (cross, same, interaction) are pooled pre-registered criteria with stated paired game-level CIs (+/-1.2, +/-1.75, +/-2.1) replacing the 5-of-6 sign test, with per-cell CIs excluding 0 in >= 4 of 6 as secondary. P2 (new, scaffold): F1 vs F1r isolates scaffold conversion from thought deletion so the title's 'thoughts' claim has its own falsifier. P3 (was P2, rewriter): F4 token-capped to F2 per item so the contrast is content-only; seeds raised to 4; criterion stated as pooled CI upper bound; memory-absent and matched F4 added per the binding rule; the SkillAligner execution-time variant cut for budget. P4 (was P3): re-anchored on S(F3) - S(F1r), a same-actions same-length authorship swap that P1 does not fix, with F3 token-matched to F1r; the difference-of-differences kept as clause (b) with its own +/-2.2 CI, a +/-5 band and a post-hoc-offset correction. P5 (was P4): F5 rebuilt as teacher-forced foreign thoughts over the whole Q-self pool (no both-succeeded subset, so item count and coverage match), compared with a post-hoc self-authored comparator F5-self on the same items at 6 seeds (+/-2.1 pooled). P6 (was P5): 4 seeds, criterion as CI upper bound anchored on Measurement C's +17.2, plus an F2 - F6 clause. Gate 0 made pooled with stated noise and demoted to framing only. Cut: matched-token F2, SkillAligner variant, k=1 cells, unrelated-type placebo (cited from Measurement C blind1), F6 from 3 cells to 2. Added: F1r, F5-self, memory-absent and matched F4. Budget 60,300 episodes with phase arithmetic and a pre-registered cut order. Sharpness kept: the central claim is stronger, not weaker - a writer x reader interaction on byte-identical injected strings plus two authorship-swap arms that say the harm belongs to whoever wrote the thoughts; no clause was hedged into a measurement study and every predicted value still has a named falsifying outcome outside the stated noise.
